WHAT WE DO

Our team of Elite Experts allows us to offer an extensive range of professional industrial, commercial and residential roofing services.
Our roofing management solutions cover both new construction and existing buildings.

ROOFING CONSTRUCTION

Our team at Elite Roofing works seamlessly with clients, architects, and engineers in the pre-construction and construction phase to provide optimal design and functionality.

Learn More

Roofing Maintenance + Services

Over time, existing roof membranes can become weakened or damaged. Our team installs additional roofing over the existing membrane without removing the existing membrane.

Learn More

ROOF REPLACEMENT

Our technicians assess your roofing needs, remove existing damaged roof covering, and install a replacement that is energy efficient and works with your buildings integral structures.

Learn More
